meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
If you’re acne-prone and want to stay **under ₹700**, I’d prioritize a **2% salicylic acid serum** if you get active pimples, blackheads, or clogged pores.

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹549*

### [Deconstruct Pore Control Serum]()
*₹639*

### [Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Skin Clearing Serum]()
*₹399*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹314*

### My picks

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum — ~₹549**  
A straightforward 2% salicylic-acid option for acne, blackheads and oily skin. Minimalist currently lists it at ₹522–₹549 depending on size/offer. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best if your skin gets irritated: Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic — ₹550 MRP**  
It combines 2% salicylic acid with cica, zinc and niacinamide, so it’s a nice choice if you want acne treatment plus soothing/barrier-supporting ingredients. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/products/dot-key-cica-2-salicylic-acne-control-serum-with-zinc-for-clear-skin-reduces-blackheads-whiteheads-oily-acne-prone-skin?_fid=46ad3edce&_pos=4&_ss=c&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Best 2-in-1 for oily skin: Deconstruct Pore Control — ~₹599**  
It has **2% liposomal salicylic acid + 3% niacinamide**, targeting both clogged pores and excess oil. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/pore-control-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Budget alternative: The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide — ~₹314**  
A 2% salicylic-acid + niacinamide formula if you want to spend less. Current listed pricing can vary by retailer. [www.nykaaman.com](https://www.nykaaman.com/dp/serums-for-acne?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What I'd buy
If I had to choose **one without knowing anything else about your skin: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**.

Use it **2–3 nights a week initially**, then increase if your skin tolerates it. Don't start with daily use, and wear sunscreen in the daytime. If your acne is severe, painful/cystic, or leaving scars, a dermatologist is a better route than adding stronger serums.

If you tell me **your skin type (oily/dry/combination) + whether you mainly have pimples, blackheads, or acne marks**, I can narrow it down to the best **₹300–700 option** for you.
